sloka: तौ वनानि गिरीन् चैव सरितः च सरांसि च ।निखिलेन विचिन्वन्तौ सीताम् दशरथ आत्मजौ ॥३-६१-२०॥
transliteration: tau vanāni girīn caiva saritaḥ ca sarāṁsi ca ।nikhilena vicinvantau sītām daśaratha ātmajau ॥3-61-20॥

translations.english: The two sons of Dasaratha went on searching for Sita in forests, mountains, rivers, ponds everywhere.
